trigger: curl older than 7.84 on a contributor host (Ubuntu 22.04 ships 7.81)
classification_rationale: the comment documented a curl >= 7.84 requirement that nothing enforced; the plan required the guard
summary: Category 7 read %header{} unconditionally; on curl 7.68-7.83 the Retry-After assertion would false-FAIL and below 7.68 the probe would mis-report as 'limiter not triggered'. Found independently by the Codex functional reviewer, the Spec sub-agent and the Standards sub-agent. Fixed: version guard, 7.68-7.83 skips and logs the Retry-After assertion, <7.68 fails with an explicit message (46e62eded; bare-429 match fix df446ffea). Live-verified with curl shims 7.83 / 7.60 / N/A.

trigger: relabel agent.storage.clear to interactive or drop the 'server' spelling
classification_rationale: the drift guard was presented as pinning the classes but only checked default exclusion
summary: The risk-table test accepted any non-default label, so a Forensics-row definition relabelled interactive, or 'server' removed from SERVER_ONLY_PLUGINS, stayed green (confirmed by two offline probes). Fixed: Forensics rows must be exactly forensic, Destructive rows destructive/network-disrupt/interactive; spelling, override precedence, ALL_RISKS and --risks acceptance pinned (46e62eded). Mutation-checked.

trigger: someone reintroduces the early-pass block
classification_rationale: removing the is_server_side auto-pass was a behaviour change with no test that failed on reversion
summary: Restoring the deleted HTTP-200 early return would have stayed green. Fixed: fake-client test asserting a server-side definition with no agent response FAILS (poll_timeout_s=0, no sleeps) and passes with a response (46e62eded); mutation restoring the block fails exactly that test.

trigger: a regression in the SKILL.md orchestration snippets
classification_rationale: Puppeteer SKIP, Security-after-wait ordering and the --instructions gate row live in SKILL.md prose snippets
summary: Codex rated HIGH because no automated test exercises the three SKILL.md orchestration changes. They are markdown bash snippets run by the /test pipeline itself, so the full /test is their test; no hermetic seam exists without moving the orchestration into a script (out of scope). The full /test run records the Puppeteer SKIP row and the ordering; the standalone --instructions row stays unverified unless run. Superseded if the full /test shows a defect.

trigger: revert to the old helper
classification_rationale: a regression test for the here-string helper form; d34151384 shipped the same helper fix without one
summary: No test distinguishes the fixed-string here-string matcher from the old regex pipeline. The change copies d34151384 verbatim; every call site was grepped (58) and none depends on regex semantics.

trigger: a contributor reads the docstring to learn the classes
classification_rationale: the runner docstring still said '217' and listed only the old risk classes, contradicting ALL_RISKS
summary: Docstring lines 3, 24-25, 30-33 and the class comment were not updated for forensic/server-internal and the plugin rule; found by the Standards and Spec sub-agents. Fixed in 5926d6c81.

trigger: a reader trusts the comment
classification_rationale: a comment described the echo|grep pipeline form of assert_contains that this diff replaced
summary: Comment at the OpenAPI check named the old helper implementation. Fixed in 5926d6c81.

trigger: a new caller omits the plugin
classification_rationale: smell: a default plugin='' silently falls through to safe/mutating when a caller forgets it
summary: classify() had a defaulted plugin argument with one production caller. Fixed: the default is removed (5926d6c81).

trigger: a contributor runs --risks destructive|forensic|server-internal and gets a wall of FAILs
classification_rationale: docs called destructive/forensic/server-internal 'opt-in' although the runner sends no agent ids so they can only return 400/503; the runner gap pre-dates this diff (pre-merge runner identical) but the wording this diff touched implied usability
summary: Raised independently by enterprise-readiness, happy-path, unhappy-path and security-guardian. Verified: execute_instruction posts only {params}. Fixed by stating plainly in the _doc, runner docstring and instructions-tests.sh help that these classes are classification-only until the runner can supply targets (5926d6c81). Target support itself is the separate row below.

trigger: any attempt to exercise a Destructive/Forensics definition
classification_rationale: the Instructions runner has no way to supply explicit targets, so Destructive/Forensics definitions are not exercisable at all
summary: Pre-existing capability gap (the pre-merge runner was identical); deferred as its own change because target selection is a new surface (which agent, safety rails). Filed after the push go.

trigger: content/definitions moved or the plugin key renamed
classification_rationale: the main drift check could pass on nothing if the definitions list were empty or plugin blank
summary: Verified by in-process mutation (defs=[] and plugin='' stayed green). Fixed: matched-definition floor >= 20 of both kinds, definitions-side vacuity test, override ids must name definitions (5926d6c81). Mutation-checked.

trigger: someone widens DEFAULT_RISKS
classification_rationale: the test checked labels but not that those labels stay out of the default run
summary: Widening DEFAULT_RISKS to include forensic stayed green. Fixed: assert DEFAULT_RISKS shares nothing with the five opt-in classes (5926d6c81). Mutation-checked.

trigger: ROW regex stops matching a row shape
classification_rationale: the >100 / >10 floors would pass after losing half the catalogue rows
summary: Found by quality-engineer and unhappy-path. Fixed: parsed row count and forensic row count are cross-checked against raw counts of the source text (5926d6c81); the Destructive arm and comment stripping followed at Gate 8 (9f2f2dcc5).

trigger: ALLOWED widened with safe
classification_rationale: synthetic negatives used only 'mutating', so widening ALLOWED to include safe stayed green
summary: Fixed: safe and server-internal added as negatives; fail cases assert the note; the pass case no longer races a 1s deadline (5926d6c81). Mutation-checked.

trigger: a definition is renamed and its override orphaned
classification_rationale: orphan override ids and unknown class values were silent
summary: Fixed: override ids must name definitions and values must be in ALL_RISKS (5926d6c81). Mutation-checked with an orphan id and a bogus class.

trigger: macOS GUI/launchd shell with soft nofile 256
classification_rationale: on a 256-descriptor shell 415 of 500 transfers came back 000 and the failure blamed the limiter
summary: Found by sre and unhappy-path (reproduced: 415x000, 85x401, curl exit 23). Fixed: raise the soft descriptor limit below 1024 (-Sn, so the hard limit is untouched, 027cfc9e3) and log the status histogram and curl exit code on failure. Live-verified: soft 256 passes 63/63, hard-locked 256 prints the histogram, limiter-off prints 500 x 401.

trigger: server workers held by keep-alive connections
classification_rationale: the burst curl had no bound; queued connections behind keep-alive workers could stall up to the keep-alive timeout
summary: Fixed: --max-time 60 (5926d6c81); responses already printed still count. The observed run is about 3s.

trigger: --http-worker-threads or --max-sse-streams lowered below the bucket
classification_rationale: the probe relies on the worker pool (264) exceeding the login bucket (200) and nothing says so
summary: Fixed: comment records the coupling and what silently breaks if the pool shrinks below the bucket (5926d6c81). Verified true against the code by the Gate 8 docs-writer.

trigger: curl --version output not starting with N.N
classification_rationale: a non-numeric curl version aborted under set -u with an unbound variable instead of the explicit message
summary: Found by unhappy-path and security-guardian. Fixed: numeric guards fall back to 0 so the explicit 'needs curl >= 7.68' failure fires (5926d6c81). Live-verified with a 'curl N/A' shim.

trigger: a reader trusts the comment
classification_rationale: comment said every login serialises on the per-user lock and quoted unverifiable run counts
summary: Fixed: 'logins for the same username serialise on a per-username mutex' and the run counts moved to the commit message (5926d6c81). The mutex is striped (256 stripes) and taken only when the lockout threshold is set; the Gate 8 docs-writer judged the wording acceptable.

trigger: a reader looks for --risk
classification_rationale: docstring said '--risk filter' but the flag is --risks
summary: Fixed in 5926d6c81.

trigger: a reader trusts the comment
classification_rationale: comment named only reason=unclassified; the denials were 31 unclassified and 2 forbidden
summary: Fixed: 'unclassified or forbidden' (5926d6c81); both appear in the reason list at server.cpp:1686.

trigger: a reader looks for --strict
classification_rationale: the risk-table _doc referred to a --strict mode the runner does not have
summary: Pre-existing line in a file this diff edits; replaced by a pointer to the drift test (5926d6c81).

trigger: a reader trusts the diagram
classification_rationale: the SKILL.md phase diagram still listed e2e-security as part of the parallel fan-out
summary: Found by consistency-auditor and build-ci. Fixed in 5926d6c81.

trigger: contributor on stock Ubuntu 22.04
classification_rationale: the curl floor appeared only in a script comment, not where contributors read prerequisites; ruled below the six REQUIRED-doc categories so recorded as NICE
summary: Fixed: one prerequisite line in the /test skill (5926d6c81).

trigger: reading test-runs.db trends
classification_rationale: risk-filtered definitions get no per-definition row or metric, so a PASS Instructions row hides 111 skips; the diff widens the effect (28 definitions moved from visible FAIL to uncounted skip)
summary: Pre-existing behaviour; fix is an instructions_skip metric and skipped ids in the outcomes JSON. Deferred as its own small change. Filed after the push go.

trigger: a large haystack at an inline check under pipefail
classification_rationale: the same echo|grep -q SIGPIPE-under-pipefail shape remains inline in e2e-mcp-test.sh (291/328/358), e2e-mcp-haiku-test.sh and integration-test.sh
summary: Raised by consistency-auditor, security-guardian and unhappy-path as outside-diff questions. d34151384 deliberately scoped to the helpers. Sweep deferred. Filed after the push go.

trigger: operator points the runner at a non-UAT server
classification_rationale: the runner accepts any --dashboard URL with the admin password and broadcasts safe+mutating definitions
summary: Pre-existing, not worsened (the default run now broadcasts fewer definitions). Dev tooling run against a throwaway stack; not pursuing a guard.

trigger: a definition with plugin 'Server '
classification_rationale: a plugin spelled with whitespace or different case misses the exact server-only tuple
summary: Author-typed YAML; the miss falls through to mutating and fails loudly with 503 in the live gate. The exact tuple is deliberate (the old startswith() matched too much).

trigger: a destructive-by-content definition is renamed
classification_rationale: 24 of the 53 overrides are on no Destructive/Forensics row, so the drift test cannot guard them (a renamed definition would fall to mutating)
summary: Pre-existing; the new integrity test catches the orphan half (stale ids). Extending the guard to non-capability-derived classes needs a different source of truth.

trigger: a future non-cp1252 byte in a definition
classification_rationale: the runner opens YAML/JSON with the locale encoding; the Windows leg is cp1252
summary: Checked: every content/definitions YAML and the table decode under cp1252, so there is no failure today. Not changing.

trigger: reading timing trends
classification_rationale: standalone --instructions records timings under 'instructions' while the full run and trend example use 'phase5-instructions'; the .codex mirror is thinner than the .claude skill
summary: Pre-existing and unchanged by this diff.

trigger: a comment or non-row initialiser matches the raw pattern
classification_rationale: the raw-count cross-check could false-red on a comment mentioning .plugin = and its message named only one cause
summary: Fixed: raw counts taken off comment-stripped text and both messages name the second cause (9f2f2dcc5).

trigger: a row spelled other than DispatchClass::Destructive
classification_rationale: the Destructive arm had no raw-count cross-check unlike Forensics
summary: Fixed: parsed Destructive dispatch_class count compared with the raw count (9f2f2dcc5). Mutation-checked (a mis-spelling regex fails the parse test).
